input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The body of the Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or committed-volume obligation on Sparkling: fees are as set out in the Fee Schedule, maintenance runs in one-year renewable terms, and we may exit on 90 days' notice without penalty. Schedule "A" was not provided, so we will confirm no minimum licence counts or committed maintenance years appear there.

input.quote: Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Termination obligations run one way: we must stop using and return the Software, but there is no transition assistance, no return or export of Sparkling's data (including converted data held in Garman's possession) and no deletion certification. Source-code escrow (Section 16) gives continuity of the Software only, not an exit path. We inserted a Section 17(d) with six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in machine-readable form within 30 days and certified deletion (90 days' assistance is our fallback).
